# S93 — Read only the sections an agent implements against

`show ID --section NAME` reads back one section, but an agent that wants the boundary
plus acceptance still pulls the whole ~4 KB slice. Let `--section` take several names,
or add a projection (e.g. `--implement`) returning just boundary + acceptance + deps,
so the agent reads exactly what it codes against instead of the full slice.

## Failing tests

1. Repeating `show ID --section NAME` returns only matching sections, in slice order.
2. One section without `--context` keeps the current `{id, section, body}` JSON shape.
3. `--context` adds item title, dependencies, and boundary while retaining only selected
   sections; text and JSON output both contain only that projection.
4. Missing sections, an unpromoted item, and `--context` without `--section` return clear
   errors.

## Implement

Make `show --section` repeatable. Preserve its existing single-section response when
exactly one section is requested without context. For multiple names, return an ordered
`sections` array containing only matches; preserve the slice's section order, including
repeated headings. If any requested name is absent, refuse the request.

Add `--context`, valid only with at least one `--section`. Its projection includes the
item id/title/dependencies, slice boundary, and selected sections. Do not hardcode section
headings in production code: each project chooses which acceptance sections to request.
Document a call selecting Failing tests, Implement, and Check. Keep full `show ID` output
unchanged.

## Check

The documented JSON command returns only the requested acceptance/implementation
sections plus title, dependencies, and boundary. Existing single-section and full-slice
reads retain their current behavior. Focused and full tests pass, `slicer check` is clean.
